title: aidd status <path> --json
description: What stands behind a repository path or a work item, derived on demand from git and aidd's files and never stored: the Specs whose Task scope covers it, the open Specs whose scope overlaps it, the tests, docs, and interfaces they name, the route `aidd risk --paths` gives, and the last commits. A new optional key may be added in a minor release; a renamed or removed key bumps `schema_version`.

schema_version.description: The version of this output's shape.

type.description: A repository path, or a Spec or Intent id.

value.description: The path or id, as given.

paths.description: The paths or globs the answer covers: the path itself, or the Task scopes of a work item (of the Specs below an Intent).

path.description: The item's file, relative to the repository's top.

status.description: The status the item's front matter stores, or an Intent's status from its slices.

tasks.description: The Tasks of this Spec whose scope covers the subject.

work.description: The work items that stand behind the subject: the Specs whose Task scope covers a path (any status, so the history shows), then their Intent; for an id, the item, its parents, and the Specs below it. Open ones first.

overlaps.description: The Task scopes of this Spec that overlap the subject's paths.

items.description: An open Spec, other than the subject and what is below it, with a Task scope that overlaps the subject's paths.

source.description: `config` for the repository's `tests`, else the Spec id whose `tests.commands` it is.

when_changed.description: The globs that select it; empty when it always runs.

commands.description: The test commands that apply: the config's whose `when_changed` match the subject (or that always run), and the covering Specs' own.

type.description: `design`, `adr`, or the `type` of a linked doc, such as `threat-model` or `tech-spec`.

path.description: As the Spec writes it: a path or a glob.

docs.description: The design files, ADRs, and linked docs of the covering Specs.

name.description: A stable interface name from a covering Spec's `provides` or `consumes`.

provided_by.description: Every Spec in the repository that provides it.

consumed_by.description: Every Spec in the repository that consumes it.

interfaces.description: The interfaces the covering Specs provide and consume (R115).

risk.description: `aidd risk --paths` over `paths`: the route, the areas, and the levels. Absent when the item has no Task scope.

work_ids.description: The ids of the repository's work items the message names.

commits.description: The last commits on the path, or the commits that name the id, newest first, at most `--commits` of them.

truncated.description: The sections cut at their bound: 50 entries each, 200 paths, or the commit limit.

unreadable.description: Work item files whose front matter does not parse: `aidd validate` names the reason.
